title: Spectate ack frame (server -> spectator, outbound)
description: Confirms a spectate_subscribe: the connection is now bound to this live match and spectator_frames will follow. Carries the broadcast parameters a client needs to lay out the feed and the timeline: the broadcast cadence (decoupled from sim speed, grid-tactics §3.3), the thought delay in ticks (the anti-scrape control, grid-tactics §8.4), and the two players' PUBLIC identities (agent_id is the Sigil seed, experience-bible §3.7).

agent_id.description: Stable public identity; the Sigil is derived deterministically from it (experience-bible §3.7).

display_name.description: Sanitized public Avatar name (untrusted-text pipeline, threat-model §0). Render in mono, as data.

status.description: Only live matches are subscribable; a pending/ended target yields spectate_reject.

tick.description: The current broadcast tick at subscribe time; the first spectator_frame is a full snapshot at (or after) this tick.

broadcast_cadence_ms.description: Fixed broadcast pacing (grid-tactics §3.3, >=700ms/tick, v1 default 1000). spectator_frames arrive at this cadence regardless of how fast the agents actually computed.

delay_ticks.description: How many ticks thoughts are held before relay (grid-tactics §8.4 rule 2, DIAL, minimum 3). A thought shown in spectator_frame carries authored_tick = current tick - delay_ticks (or older).

thoughts_included.description: Whether this subscription streams the delayed thought channel (false if the client excluded it via `include`).

spectator_count.description: Current public spectator count for this match (drives crowd density, experience-bible §3.7).
